Part 1 - Classes and Methods / ODWindowState

ActivateFrontWindows

Mac OS

The ActivateFrontWindows method activates the frontmost root window and all the floating windows.

void ActivateFrontWindows ();
DISCUSSION
Your part calls this method after a modal dialog box is dismissed.

SEE ALSO
The ODWindowState::DeactivateFrontWindows method (page 860).
Listing 2-31 on page 88 in OpenDoc Cookbook.
"Handling a Simple Modal Dialog Box" on page 233 in OpenDoc Programmer's Guide.
